verses.en: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
verses.pt: Ora irmãos, nós vos rogamos quanto à vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e à nossa reunião com ele,
verses.en_web: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together to him, we ask you
verses.en_bbe: Now as to the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ, and our meeting with him, it is our desire, my brothers,

verses.en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
verses.pt: Que vós não vos abaleis facilmente em vosso entendimento, e não vos perturbeis, nem por espírito, nem por palavra, nem por carta como que escrita por nós, como se o dia de Cristo já estivesse perto.
verses.en_web: not to be quickly shaken in your mind, and not be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
verses.en_bbe: That you may not be moved in mind or troubled by a spirit, or by a word, or by a letter as from us, with the suggestion that the day of the Lord is even now come;

verses.en: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
verses.pt: Ninguém vos engane em maneira nenhuma; porque não virá esse dia sem que primeiro venha a apostasia, e se manifeste o homem do pecado, o filho da perdição.
verses.en_web: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction,
verses.en_bbe: Give no belief to false words: because there will first be a falling away from the faith, and the revelation of the man of sin, the son of destruction,

verses.en: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
verses.pt: O qual se opõe e se levanta sobre tudo o que se chama Deus, ou sobre tudo que é adorado; por isso ele se sentará no templo de Deus, como se fosse Deus, fazendo-se parecer Deus.
verses.en_web: he who opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped; so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
verses.en_bbe: Who puts himself against all authority, lifting himself up over all which is named God or is given worship; so that he takes his seat in the Temple of God, putting himself forward as God.

verses.en: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
verses.pt: Não vos lembrais, que enquanto ainda estava convosco, eu vos dizia estas coisas?
verses.en_web: Don’t you remember that, when I was still with you, I told you these things?
verses.en_bbe: Have you no memory of what I said when I was with you, giving you word of these things?

verses.en: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
verses.pt: E agora sabeis o que o detém, para que a seu próprio tempo seja manifestado.
verses.en_web: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
verses.en_bbe: And now it is clear to you what is keeping back his revelation till the time comes for him to be seen.

verses.en: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
verses.pt: Porque o mistério da injustiça já opera; só há aquele que agora o detém, até que seja tirado do meio.
verses.en_web: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
verses.en_bbe: For the secret of evil is even now at work: but there is one who is keeping back the evil till he is taken out of the way.

verses.en: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
verses.pt: E então será manifestado aquele injusto, ao qual o Senhor destruirá, pelo sopro de sua boca, e o aniquilará pelo aparecimento de sua vinda;
verses.en_web: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth, and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
verses.en_bbe: And then will come the revelation of that evil one, whom the Lord Jesus will put to death with the breath of his mouth, and give to destruction by the revelation of his coming;

verses.en: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.pt: Aquele injusto cuja vinda é conforme o agir de Satanás, com todo poder, e sinais, e milagres falsos.
verses.en_web: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.en_bbe: Even the one whose coming is marked by the working of Satan, with all power and signs and false wonders,

verses.en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.pt: E com todo engano de injustiça nos que perecem; porque não receberam o amor da verdade para se salvarem.
verses.en_web: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.en_bbe: And with every deceit of wrongdoing among those whose fate is destruction; because they were quite without that love of the true faith by which they might have salvation.

verses.en: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
verses.pt: E por isso Deus lhes enviará a ação do erro, para que creiam na mentira.
verses.en_web: Because of this, God sends them a working of error, that they should believe a lie;
verses.en_bbe: And for this cause, God will give them up to the power of deceit and they will put their faith in what is false:

verses.en: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.pt: Para que sejam condenados todos os que não creram na verdade, mas tiveram prazer na injustiça.
verses.en_web: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.en_bbe: So that they all may be judged, who had no faith in what is true, but took pleasure in evil.

verses.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
verses.pt: Mas sempre devemos dar graças a Deus por vós, irmãos, que sois amados pelo Senhor, pois Deus vos escolheu desde o princípio para a salvação, em santificação do Espírito, e fé na verdade;
verses.en_web: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth;
verses.en_bbe: But it is right for us to give praise to God at all times for you, brothers, loved by the Lord, because it was the purpose of God from the first that you might have salvation, being made holy by the Spirit and by faith in what is true:

verses.en: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Para a qual ele vos chamou por meio do nosso Evangelho, para a obtenção da glória de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And in this purpose he gave you a part through the good news of which we were the preachers, even that you might have part in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
verses.pt: Portanto, irmãos, ficai firmes, e retende as tradições que vos foram ensinadas, seja por palavra, seja por carta nossa.
verses.en_web: So then, brothers, stand firm, and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word, or by letter.
verses.en_bbe: So then, brothers, be strong in purpose, and keep the teaching which has been given to you by word or by letter from us.

verses.en: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
verses.pt: E ele mesmo, o nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e nosso Deus e Pai, que nos amou e em graça nos deu uma eterna consolação e boa esperança;
verses.en_web: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
verses.en_bbe: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who had love for us and has given us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

verses.en: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
verses.pt: Ele console vossos corações, e vos fortaleça em toda boa palavra e obra.
verses.en_web: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
verses.en_bbe: Give you comfort and strength in every good work and word.
